autotrade.message.inventory.full: §eInventory full - trading paused until output container frees space
autotrade.message.void.exhausted: §cVillager trades have been exhausted - the void unload buffer may be too small, or the rig's chunk stays loaded (spawn/force-loaded chunks). Raise Void Unload Delay or relocate the rig
autotrade.message.io.not_container: §cContainer operation failed: target position %s is not a container (%s), aborted. Check the container coordinates in IO Input/IO Output
autotrade.message.io.open_failed: §cContainer operation failed: failed to open the container screen %s times in a row, aborted
autotrade.message.void.return_overlap: §eVoid return trigger position overlaps an IO container coordinate - return trigger disabled (move the trigger block or the container coordinates)
autotrade.gui.item_io.inactive_hint: Not active - no enabled trade pair uses this item
autotrade.gui.item_io.empty: §7No items derived from trade pairs - add trade pairs in the Trade Pairs tab
config.comment.enabled: Trade with villagers in range when enabled
config.comment.trademode: Trade mode: Static Trade, Moving Trade, Void Trade
config.comment.containeriointerval: Min ticks between container operations (0 = check every tick)
config.comment.containerioidleinterval: Ticks to wait when no container operation is needed
config.comment.trapchestdelay: Ticks to keep the trapped chest screen open after opening (stabilizes the redstone signal and leaves time for the mechanism to react); shared by container IO and the void return trigger
config.comment.opentimeout: Timeout ticks waiting for a screen to open after interacting (trade screen, container screen, or return trigger block); shared by all screen-open waits
config.comment.tasktimeout: Max ticks a single task may run before it is force-aborted and control returns to idle decisions (a failed void return trigger is retried next cycle). Prevents stuck states (e.g. trade offers never syncing). 0 = disabled. Raise if Void Teleport Timeout or Void Unload Delay is set above this value
config.comment.tradeinterval: Min ticks between trade rounds in static mode (100 ticks = 5 seconds)
config.comment.voidteleporttimeout: Timeout ticks waiting for the villager to disappear (player teleport) after the trade screen opened (100 ticks = 5 seconds); close the screen and skip the villager when it expires; 0 = wait indefinitely
config.comment.voidunloaddelay: Ticks to wait after the villager disappears (player teleport) before trading, so the server finishes unloading the villager's chunk and trade counts are not persisted to the villager (20 ticks = 1 second; 0 = trade immediately; raise if trades keep being exhausted)
config.comment.voidreturntype: Void-mode block type used to teleport the player back after a trade round: None (disabled), Trapped Chest, Button, Lever
config.comment.voidreturnpos: Position of the return trigger block as "x y z" (e.g. -13 60 -1)
config.comment.voidreturnstrict: Strictly validate that the block type matches the return trigger block type; mismatches are skipped with a warning (default off = only check block existence and distance)
config.comment.paireditgive: Click [Grab Give] to use the item in hand
config.comment.paireditgive2: Optional second give item for 2-for-1 trades (leave empty for single-cost pairs)
config.comment.paireditget: Click [Grab Get] to use the item in hand
config.comment.paireditlimit: Max amount of the FIRST give item per trade (the 2nd give item is not price-adjusted and has no limit)
